training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of Radar Block Diagram and Signal Flow; Safety: No live equipment handling; Supervision: Instructor monitors PPT navigation.
intro_questions: What is the full form of RADAR?
Define the basic principle of communication theory.
List two prerequisites for this lesson.

development.content:
Basic Theory of Communication
Radar System Introduction
Radar Block Diagram Components
Pulse Transmission and Reception
Signal Processing Basics

Primary Radar System Principles
Secondary Radar System Principles
Transponder Functionality
Interrogation and Reply Cycle
Comparison of Primary and Secondary

Radar Range Equation Factors
Antenna Beamwidth and Gain
Clutter and Noise Sources
Display Types: PPI and A-Scope
Summary of System Architecture

summary_questions: Explain the fundamental difference between primary and secondary radar systems.
Describe the role of the transponder in a secondary radar system.
